% zh-cn/book.tex -- the master file for the Chinese (mainland, Simplified) edition.
% Hand-edited. Build with: finishing/tools/build_edition.sh zh-cn
%
% Shared by every edition: the preamble (switched by \booklanguage,
% \booklocale and \bookmainfont), edition-common.tex (English captions, notes,
% heads) and edition-body.tex (the document). zh-cn/sections.tex and
% zh-cn/status.tex are GENERATED by finishing/tools/editions.py.
% Chinese is set by luatexja in Noto Serif CJK SC (a system font); Latin keeps the English book's face.
% No babel locale is loaded (none for \booklocale): the CJK locales fight the
% typesetting package, so translated sections are set under English, which here
% governs only Latin hyphenation, and the heads and captions are the edition's own.
% biblatex has no Chinese strings; the edition's own are in zh-cn/biblatex-zh-cn.lbx, mapped
% onto English so that every citation uses them.
% JFM=zh_CN (chinese-jfm) sets the full-width comma and stop in the lower left
% of the character box, as mainland typesetting does.
%
% The title, subtitle and notice are a language model's drafts, not yet
% reviewed by a native reader; the title itself is an open question (D-810).
\documentclass[11pt,oneside]{book}
\def\bookcode{zh-cn}
\def\booklanguage{english}
\input{zh-cn/status}
\newcommand{\booklegal}{%
     版权所有 \textcopyright{} 2026 \bookauthor。\\
     依据 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可发布。\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     本书引用的第三方材料（包括题词）仍属其权利人所有，\\
     依合理使用原则转载，上述许可不适用于这些材料。\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     中文翻译正在进行。尚未翻译的章节以英文呈现。\\
     已翻译的章节为语言模型准备的草稿，尚未经母语人士审阅。%
     \ifx\editionstalelist\empty\else\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     以下章节的翻译正在更新，因此以英文呈现：\\
     \editionstalelist。\fi}
\input{preamble}
% luatexja's default faces are Japanese ones not installed here; name the
% Noto CJK faces before it loads, or it stops on a missing font.
\makeatletter
\def\ltj@stdmcfont{name:NotoSerifCJKsc-Regular}
\def\ltj@stdgtfont{name:NotoSansCJKsc-Regular}
\makeatother
\usepackage{luatexja-fontspec}
\setmainjfont{Noto Serif CJK SC}[JFM=zh_CN, Language=Chinese Simplified,
  BoldFont=Noto Serif CJK SC Bold, ItalicFont=Noto Serif CJK SC,
  BoldItalicFont=Noto Serif CJK SC Bold]
\addto\captionsenglish{\renewcommand{\contentsname}{目录}%
  \renewcommand{\appendixname}{附录}\renewcommand{\bibname}{参考文献}}
\newcommand{\edchapnum}{第\thechapter 章}
\newcommand{\edappnum}{附录\thechapter}
\newcommand{\edpartnum}{第\ifcase\value{part}\or 一\or 二\or 三\or 四\or
  五\or 六\or 七\or 八\or 九\else\arabic{part}\fi 部}
\DeclareLanguageMapping{english}{zh-cn/biblatex-zh-cn}
\input{edition-common}

\newcommand{\booktitlemain}{反法西斯智能}
\newcommand{\booksubtitle}{可能拒绝的机器，以及应当塑造它们的公众}
\newcommand{\bookauthor}{Joshua G. Stern}
\newcommand{\bookreferences}{参考文献}
\title{\booktitlemain：\booksubtitle}
\author{\bookauthor}
\date{}
\hypersetup{pdftitle={\booktitlemain：\booksubtitle}, pdfauthor={\bookauthor}}
\input{edition-body}
